record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare JET_PUNCH: Finizen (3 stars, passive FINIZEN), Palafin (3 stars, passive FINIZEN) and Palafin Hero (4 stars, no passive). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count, base speed and the FINIZEN passive. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage to the cast target only. The requested amount is the caster's CURRENT speed stat multiplied by 1 (stars 1-3), 1.5 (4 stars) or 3 (5 stars and as the fallback). No status, buff or area is involved. The three listed units have 3, 3 and 4 stars, so their multipliers are 1, 1 and 1.5.

targeting.note: The strategy hits `target` directly; no check of its team or position. The default cast animation is skipped (preventDefaultAnim true), which does not change gameplay.

declaredRaw.label: requested damage multiplier of the caster's current speed (not a damage amount)

effects.scaling: requested = multiplier[stars-1] x pokemon.speed at the moment the cast resolves (current speed, including buffs, debuffs and the 0..300 clamp; for the base stat values 64/64/80 this is 64, 64 and 120 requested). handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the hit unit) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with a DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 when the unit has protect / skydiving / magicBounce. See knowledge/07367c34/core-mechanics.md section A.

starBehavior.note: The multiplier table has five entries (stars 1..5); the listed units use entries 3, 3 and 4. The FINIZEN passive's transformToHero renames the entity to PALAFIN_HERO and adds +16 speed (and +18 attack, +5 defense, +5 special defense, full hp) but the block that was read does not change `stars`, so a transformed Finizen/Palafin keeps multiplier 1 while its speed is 16 higher; the base-form PALAFIN_HERO unit has 4 stars and multiplier 1.5.

record.positionalConditions: None: the hit lands on the cast target regardless of position.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and reads the caster's speed again, so the damage follows any speed changes between casts. The FINIZEN passive can transform Finizen/Palafin into PALAFIN_HERO mid-fight (when 5 allies, or all allies, have been KO'd; immediately if there are none), which raises speed by 16 for later casts.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: multiplier x current speed (base-stat examples: Finizen 64, Palafin 64, Palafin Hero 1.5 x 80 = 120; a transformed Finizen/Palafin reads speed 80 with multiplier 1 unless stars change elsewhere). Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage and is 0 for protected units.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
